_comment: Copy this file to config/config.local.json and fill in the values. That location is git-ignored and must never be committed.

runtime._comment: audit_folder is never cleared by any tool.

knowledge._comment: The board's knowledge source: a folder of Markdown notes (an Obsidian vault). Read for every question, written only after you confirm a memory entry on closing a topic. token_budget caps the notes sent per model call. Both are editable in the browser interface's Options.

server._comment: The browser interface listens on 127.0.0.1 only.

provider._comment: endpoint is the record of which endpoint was approved under AI-3; since 8 September 2026 that is the company's LiteLLM gateway, defined as provider 'azure' in the company-provided opencode.json (opencode.config_file). models.board is the provider/model string as defined in that file. token_limits stays null until a limit is decided. auto_approve is discussed in the source project's spec 3.8 (OC-6); the --auto flag is only passed when the installed OpenCode version lists it (OC-7). extra_args appends further arguments to every `opencode run`, e.g. --agent plan, one string per argument (OC-9).
